audience: Codex app users and operators updating desktop workflows
candidate_text:
Codex app 26.608 landed in the official changelog.

- Claude Code/Cowork migration flows
- Plugins screen refresh
- Broader Settings search
- Goal timer, unread alert, diff ordering, and Windows 10 rendering fixes

Source: https://developers.openai.com/codex/changelog
evidence_notes: The official Codex changelog lists Codex app 26.608 on 2026-06-09.
The changelog says Codex app 26.608 added Migrate to Codex flows for importing supported setup from Claude Code and Claude Cowork.
The changelog says the plugins screen was revamped with tabs, marketplace and category filters, keyboard navigation, and clearer install actions.
The changelog says Settings search now finds options from more panels, including Git and pets.

The changelog lists fixes or improvements for narrow-layout goal timer overlap, unread notifications during active goals, review diff ordering, and window rendering on systems without translucent backdrop support.

claims.text: Codex app 26.608 is an official Codex app changelog checkpoint.
The update adds migration flows for supported Claude Code and Claude Cowork setup imports.
The update refreshes the plugins screen and broadens Settings search.
The update includes UI and reliability fixes for goal timers, unread notifications, review diff ordering, and non-translucent window rendering.

decision.reason: The official changelog has concrete app changes that answer what changed, who can use it, and what source proves it.

caveats: This candidate is based only on the official Codex changelog; do not infer CLI, GitHub prerelease, mobile, or Decodex runtime behavior from it.
